newsitem.title: USA: Dow recovers, NYSE lifts curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow recovers, NYSE lifts curbs.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average rebounded quickly off earlier lows, prompting the New York Stock Exchange to lift curbs on index-arbitrage trading at 1527 EDT/1927 GMT, just about 10 minutes after putting the curbs in place.
The Dow was off 17 points or 0.25 percent to 7274.
The Standard & Poor's 500 Index also rebounded. Earlier, it had been off 0.86 percent but recovered to be off 0.61 percent or about five points to 833.
